15 November 2026 · Funchal, Madeira

Training week in Madeira

Twelve adult educators from Germany, Portugal and Türkiye gathered in Madeira to test and co-design non-clinical creative workshops using drawing, storytelling, drama and music.

18 January 2027 · Bonn · Madeira · Eskişehir

Local creative workshops in Bonn, Madeira and Eskişehir

One-day creative well-being workshops for adults 25+ in all three partner cities: Bonn (18 Jan), Madeira (19 Jan) and Eskişehir (20 Jan 2027). Free of charge, 20 places per city, no art skills needed.
